name: Investigator Bonded Investigator — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Investigator Bonded Investigator from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Bonded Investigator" but are not part of the Investigator Bonded Investigator entry, which is unchanged.

Some investigators, in their esoteric studies, eschew some of their training in combat and danger readiness.

Instead, they rely on the faculties of their familiar to aid them in their jobs and in times of danger.

Bonded Familiar (Ex)

At 1st level, the bonded investigator gains Familiar Bond feat as a bonus feat without having to meet the prerequisites. At 4th level, the bonded investigator gains Improved Familiar Bond as a bonus feat without needing to meet the prerequisites. This ability replaces the studied strike at 1st level.

Course of Study (Ex)

The bonded investigator cannot take a course of study that grants them a companion creature. Otherwise, their course of study progression and choices are unaffected. This ability modifies course of study.

Studied Strike (Ex)

At 3rd level, the legendary investigator begins their studied strike at +1d6 and increases it by +1d6 every odd level thereafter to a maximum of +9d6 at 19th level. This ability modifies studied strike.
